protocol.reset: original JSON once per session; set-current, land, charge before each task
protocol.timeout_source: upstream Checker GUI timeout_var initial value (500), not AGENT_TIMEOUT fallback (300)
protocol.timeout_policy: close admission, drain, freeze world, score; continue only after worker exits; no retry
protocol.inflight_policy: finish requests admitted before cutoff; refuse later and stale-lease requests
protocol.grading_state: pause simulation ticks after drain; resume before next preparation
protocol.agent_budget: upstream max_iterations=150; recursion_limit=450; not a hard tool budget

executor.scene_order: claim in frozen plan order; finish independently
executor.recovery: reuse sealed scenes; replay whole incomplete scenes only

recovery.selection_policy: all terminal HTTP 402/429 LLM failures plus all incomplete scenes, independent of task pass/fail

selected_generations.resource_scope_note: Peak is the largest sampled monitored process tree; CPU percent uses 100% per core. For simultaneous fleet RSS, attach one fleet-level monitor.

all_executed_generations.resource_scope_note: Peak is the largest sampled monitored process tree; CPU percent uses 100% per core. For simultaneous fleet RSS, attach one fleet-level monitor.

performance.note: All executed work includes abandoned generations; selected generations are used for task scoring. Resource peaks are sampled.

paper_reference.comparability: Historical deepseek-flash; local model is current official deepseek-flash. Not identical model/protocol.
